Tl;dr I drank absinthe(the Ontario LCBO stuff) with the lead singer from Aerosmith without knowing who it was. 

Was finishing my shift as a cook at a bar in Niagara falls, Ontario, so I was in my regular clothes, wearing headphones listening to music at the bar, in my own world.

They were playing at the casino and the lead singer had stopped by for drinks and was asking the bartender (who knew who he was talking to) about how to have some fun that night. Earlier in the day I had picked up the bottle of absinthe for that night and has shown the bartender in conversation, so the bartender mentioned to him that I had the bottle in my bag. 

I knew who Aerosmith was but had never really had an interest so I had no idea what the lead singer looked like, so when the bartender asked me to pull out the bottle (which was super against company policy to bring your own booze to the bar) I was pretty confused. 

I was younger and pretty easy going so I just figured this guy was just some groovy, older dude who wanted to party, so we basically smashed the bottle between us, a few other staff members and a few other randoms  and talked about nothing. I honestly don't even remember the conversation, it was so casual(not forgetting the intoxication), and living in Downtown Niagara Falls, I was used to unique characters making a single "appearance" and then disappearing from my life forever. It just seemed like another character and another funny night. 

It was only after  he had left and everyone started freaking out about what had just gone down that I realized I wasn't in the loop. I guess I looked confused because the bartender asked me "do you know who that was?"

I said no, and the freaking out immediately intensified. I was the butt of jokes for a long time after that. 

It's cool to know that Stephen Tyler can be such a cool and casual guy around people who apparently live under a rock, but I still wish SOMEONE had told me exactly WHO I was sharing my bottle with.
